analysis: Both rosters are banged up heading into the first-ever NFL game in Rio, but Dallas is clearly worse off: starting LG Tyler Smith, CB Cobie Durant and S PJ Locke were already out, and this morning brings two more confirmed losses -- S Malik Hooker (upgraded from doubtful) and starting LB DeMarvion Overshown. Thats 3 defensive backfield starters plus a starting linebacker down, and the model auto-applies an extra depth-stacking penalty for the 2 safeties lost at the same position. Ravens LT Ronnie Stanley also looks all-but-out after missing the full week, a partial offset on the other side.

The spread itself lands close to a coinflip once both sides injuries wash out (model margin -4.6 vs a market around -3 to -3.5, cover% under 50) -- not a clean edge either way. The total is the real story: the model projects 44.3 combined points against a market sitting at 53.5, a massive 9.2-point gap, with 75% of simulations going Under. Two shorthanded offenses and a Dallas secondary missing 3 starters points at a much lower-scoring game than the market currently prices, and BookMaker.eus own moneyline reprice toward Baltimore earlier this week (-154 to -178) is an independent signal pointing the same direction.
